text: The fixed shared head registers MockOSIntegration for all notification browser tests and restores the service in cleanup. It adds the Windows-specific interface when required and exposes one shared _inDoNotDisturbMode flag. The DND task toggles that flag around new-mail injection and awaits the existing no-sound helper. The head comment explains that CI can already run in Do Not Disturb mode, so unrelated tests need controlled OS state too. The initial Windows patch instead registered a per-task mock and skipped the task on non-Windows. These are written test contracts; no task, CI result, native service or playback was executed here. The original added preference tests contain assertions without messages, so those sites are historical deficiencies rather than assertion-writing examples.
title: Notification tests replace OS integration for the whole test file before each DND scenario changes mock state
